name: punchboard
description: Turn any tablet or phone into a macro pad for your computer, with deep OBS support for streaming.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p src/client/tsconfig.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.app:dev: npm run build && npm run build:server && tauri dev
scripts.test: node tests/security.test.mjs && node tests/actions.test.mjs && node tests/obs.test.mjs && node tests/sounds.test.mjs && node tests/app-volume.test.mjs && node tests/library.test.mjs && node tests/trackpad.test.mjs && node tests/touchpad.test.mjs && node tests/designer.test.mjs && node tests/tour.test.mjs && node tests/scripts.test.mjs && node tests/windows.test.mjs && node tests/i18n.test.mjs
scripts.lint:rust: cd server && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check && cd ../src-tauri && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check
